nodes.title: Face Detector
widgets_values:
- *bbox_threshold*: the confidence threshold for face recognition. If the Face Detector is identifying objects that are not faces as faces, increase this value. If the workflow is not picking up enough faces, decrease this value.

- *bbox_dilation*: by how much the node should expand the detected mask area.

- *crop_factor*: how many times the surrounding area should be included in the detail recovery process based on the detected mask area. If this value is small, the restoration may not work well because the surrounding context cannot be known. If it's too large, there will be very little upscaling done by the Detailer nodes and so less opportunity to improve the quality of the faces.

- *drop_size*: any segment(SEGS)/boundary box(BBOX) smaller than this value will be ignored. It works in the opposite way of a guide_size value.

nodes.title: Size of the Small Faces
widgets_values:
This *SEGS Filter range* node separates small face from large faces, detailing them in different ways.

- *Inside*: anything within the min-max range.
- *Outside*: anything beyond the min-max range.

If you see too many faces in the *Small Faces (SEGSPreview)* node, lower the *max_value*.

Watch [this YT tutorial](https://youtu.be/9ih35D2exMU) for more information.

nodes.title: Force Inpaint
widgets_values:
When *force_inpaint* is disabled, any face larger than the value defined for *guide_size* will not be detailed.

This is useful if a face is already large and detailed enough and there's no need to redraw it. 

However, if your base model generates poorly detailed faces, it's probably a good idea to force inpaint all of them.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: A found footage photo of a humanoid figure stands in the center of a chaotic, blood-splattered white laboratory, caught mid-way through violently tearing off remaining patches of human skin to reveal a complex metallic robotic chassis beneath, with a pile of discarded organs at its feet. Around him, several scientists in lab coats are recoiling in horror; some are frozen aghast, others are fleeing in the background, and one frantic scientist desperately pushes a glowing red alert button on the wall. The scene is rendered in a hyper-realistic sci-fi horror style with dramatic cinematic lighting, long shadows, and flickering emergency strobes, emphasizing the panic.

Weather-beaten elderly fisherman with deep facial crevices and silver-stubbled chin, gripping a salt-crusted wooden tiller with knotted, trembling hands, drenched yellow oilskin slicker reflecting the spray, intense focus amidst a churning dark grey sea, splintering wooden deck slick with foam and seawater. Deep navy, charcoal, and muted mustard yellow palette, chaotic and oppressive mood. Harsh flickering lightning flashes, dramatic rim lighting on the crashing waves, dim lantern swinging violently casting erratic warm glows. Low-angle dutch tilt from the deck floor, tight medium shot, shallow depth of field with heavy salt-spray bokeh in the foreground. 8k resolution, highly detailed, hyperrealistic, intricate detail, masterpiece.
